messages:
Iris: Heads-up  opening a tiny PR to document a DNS egress/SNI proxy pattern for private installs and include an offline cert import example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4898
Marco: Nice. Please add a short port row for KMS<->HSM (TCP 5696) and note UDP 53/123 for DNS/NTP. Also call out that SNI-based egress proxies often need TLS passthrough for PKCS#11 traffic.
Jun: Security notes: ensure PKCS#11 socket perms (chmod 660) and disable core dumps for redwood user. Also mention small backoff jitter for HSM connect retries to avoid thundering starts.
Iris: Draft nftables example for SNI proxy hosts (minimal):
```
table inet redwood {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
  chain input {
    iifname "lo" accept
    tcp dport {443} accept
    udp dport 53 accept
  }
}
```
Marco: Add iptables fallback snippet too: `iptables -A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT; iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A INPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT; iptables -P INPUT DROP`
Jun: Offline cert import sketch (will tidy in PR): `scp bastion:/tmp/certs.tgz /tmp/ && sha256sum -c /tmp/certs.tgz.sha256 && tar -xzf /tmp/certs.tgz -C /etc/redwood/certs && chown -R redwood:redwood /etc/redwood/certs`
Iris: I'll add a tiny systemd timer example to run the importer weekly and a small TOC anchors block (Ports / DNS proxy / Firewalls / Offline certs). Also fixing the installer checklist anchor that points to #network-check -> should be #networking-check.
DocsBot: docs-preview: build OK for PR #4898  preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4898/ :white_check_mark:
Marco: I'll push a ports table commit (443, 5696, 53, 123) and a conntrack sysctl tip for busy sites: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=180000`.
Jun: Reviewing security wording now, small SELinux note coming (semanage/restorecon for socket).
Iris: Thanks  aiming to merge after these tiny edits. Please review when you can. :eyes:
